_meta.description: The queue a reviewer works through before anything in the Suggestion register is built, plus a log of decisions already taken. A decision is only recorded as taken when the owner states it; this file never assumes one. Each entry names the options, what each option commits the site to, and the cheapest reversible first step.
_meta.how_to_use: Read the question, pick an option, and record it in the log at the bottom with the date. Until then the site stays exactly as it is. Nothing in this repository acts on a suggestion automatically. Decisions recorded on 2026-11-16 were made under the owner's written delegation for that session; they are reversible and each log entry names the delegation it rests on.

statuses.Open - needs your answer: Waiting on the owner. The site does nothing in the meantime.
statuses.Recorded: The owner has stated the decision and it is written in the log.

decisions.question: Should the three existing product links be regenerated under the supplied tracking ID, shopnow047c-20, after confirming it is the enrolled account Partner Tag, or should the site stop describing them as earning links?

options.commits_to: Requires an enrolled Associates account and confirmation that shopnow047c-20 is its Partner Tag. Each product link is generated or validated through the authorized workflow, its destination is checked, and a test click is confirmed in reporting before scaling.
options.reversible: Yes. Reverting to untagged links is a data change and a rebuild.

options.label: Keep the links as plain product links until a Partner Tag and Special Links are confirmed
options.commits_to: The site keeps sending readers to the products but stops claiming it earns from them, because it cannot. The disclosure sentence would have to be withdrawn, which in turn affects every page.
options.effort: One template change plus a policy-page rewrite.
options.reversible: Yes, but withdrawing and re-adding the disclosure across 21 pages is the largest single visible change the site could make.

options.label: Do nothing yet
options.commits_to: No tracking is claimed until account membership and the supplied tracking ID have been confirmed and the links are validated.

decisions.recommendation: A, only after the account confirms shopnow047c-20 as its Partner Tag and the destination plus tracking report are checked. Do not append a tag to the supplied short URLs by guesswork.

sources.ref: Operating Agreement, Section 5

decisions.recorded_choice: Option A, with the verification gate kept. The owner selected tracking ID shopnow047c-20 (brief, 2026-11-17), so the site's outbound product links are published as tagged Special Links - https://www.amazon.com/dp/<ASIN>?tag=shopnow047c-20 - in place of the short-link hrefs, and the disclosure sentence and '(paid link)' labels stay. The tag's registration and activity are confirmable only inside Associates Central (one-link-per-product test, F-57), so attribution stays 'pending confirmation'. The supplied short links are not judged valid or invalid; their compliance status is unresolved in Zone3's FLG-003.

options.effort: The prerequisite cannot be shortcut; the build change is small.
options.reversible: Yes, but a published price history cannot be un-published from a reader's memory.

options.label: No, stay a specification site
options.commits_to: Prices and ratings stay blank permanently. The site must then compete on something other than numbers, which is the testing route in D-06.

decisions.recommendation: A if the site is meant to sell; B is honest and cheap but leaves the reader's obvious question unanswered indefinitely.

decisions.question: What will the site say about who writes it and how?

options.label: Name the human reviewer and describe the pipeline
options.commits_to: A named person becomes responsible for the copy. That person must actually read it before each publish.
options.effort: One editorial note and a review step in the process.

options.label: Describe the pipeline without naming a person
options.commits_to: States that a research pipeline drafts and the owner approves, without inventing a byline. Honest, slightly colder.

options.label: Add a byline with a pen name and an avatar
options.commits_to: Google's guidance names fabricated creator profiles, including AI-generated headshots and made-up names, as a deception signal. Not recommended.

decisions.recommendation: A or B. C is the one option the cited guidance explicitly warns against.

sources.ref: Who / How / Why, and the fabricated-authorship warning

decisions.recorded_choice: Option B, plus an honest production note: the site describes its writing and checking pipeline without naming a person (no named human reviewer exists yet - Q-05 stays open) and states plainly that the copy is AI-assisted and machine-checked against official sources, never hands-on tested.
